from Soumya, with way too many feelings

A letter for you.

Dear Navera, 💗

I honestly don't know how to fit a whole friendship into a few paragraphs. There are too many laughs, too many stupid conversations, too many random moments, and definitely too many things that would make absolutely no sense to anyone except us.

But if I had to choose one thing to say today, it would be this: I'm really, really grateful that you're in my life. You have this strange little way of making ordinary days feel less ordinary. Even when we're being complete idiots, somehow those are the moments I end up remembering the most.

I hope this new year of your life gives you the kind of happiness you don't have to question, people who choose you genuinely, dreams that actually come true, and enough beautiful memories to make you smile years from now.

And yes, you are officially allowed to be dramatic today because it's your birthday. Tomorrow, unfortunately, your nonsense privileges expire. 😭

Stay exactly as wonderfully weird, soft, funny and unforgettable as you are.

Happy Birthday, Navera. 🧿🌷
Here's to you, and to all the memories we haven't made yet.
— Soumya ♡
